BENEFITS

Move the body. Train the brain.

01

Rotation

Activate your spinal engine and discover the connection between your feet and the rope. Find out where the spiral begins.

02

Coordination

Both arms work together and against each other, building left-right coordination, timing and a natural sense of rhythm.

03

Neuroplasticity

Learning a new movement pattern challenges the brain to adapt. Research on similar coordination skills, like juggling, shows measurable changes in the brain.

04

Focus

The steady rhythm pulls your attention into the present, an absorbed state many people describe as a moving meditation.

05

Shoulders & posture

Controlled, continuous swings work the muscles around the shoulders and upper back. Many opening movements are healthy for the upper back. The practice helps you understand the benefits of posture.

General wellness information, not medical advice.

Attributes

01

Physics

On the shorter side to keep the shoulders lower during swings. Super comfortable to 'Dragonroll' in smaller spaces and can allow full arm extension during 'Golf swings'. A little heavier than most 14mm ropes to give it extra momentum. Cuts through the air and produces a good 'pull' sensation.

02

Structure

Tight black-and-white braiding. Weatherproof and stylish.

03

Sound

Listen to the rope cut through the air.

WEAR IT AS AN ACCESSORY

Having a rope fastened around your chest when you are out and about is comfortable and you can wear it as a sleek looking accessory without people even knowing that it is your workout tool.

Worn with a jacket

The rope sits across the chest under an open jacket, easy to wear all day.

Denim layers

Worn over a denim jacket, the rope becomes part of the outfit.

Clean and simple

A plain white tee and an open jacket, with the rope as the only detail.
